comment: Main evidence for the leaching claim: [key] "Autumn application of cattle slurry increased nitrate leaching by 38 percent compared with spring application." [key] "On organic soils the leaching losses were nearly twice those of clay soils." Also useful for the discussion: they recommend avoiding autumn manure on organic soils and timing by soil frost instead of calendar dates.
paraText: Autumn manure application increases nitrate leaching on boreal soils, especially on organic soils (Virtanen et al. 2024).

comment: Cited for the claim that freeze-thaw cycles explain most of the annual nitrous oxide emission and that summer fluxes are small.
paraText: Freeze-thaw cycles dominate annual nitrous oxide emissions in the north (Virtanen et al. 2024).
